svg.text: CLI → Bootstrap → Pipeline → Audio/Plan → Stills/Clips → Assemble → Review → Rerender → Escalation → Artifacts
start / preflight / status / doctor / review-packet / extract-frames / quality-findings-template
run dir reservation, size/template validation, single-flight, ComfyUI/WSL preconditions
Protected payload merge, snapshot-before/after-stage, rerender canonicalization, escalation trigger
LLM outline/lyrics planning, language inference, beat/bar timing extraction, section map
Key data: genre_description, lyrics, tags, bpm, timing map, section timing, hook brief, language
Risk: LLM lyric-header reliability and planning heuristic drift
Outputs: style_lane, style_bible, section_plan, shot_plan, material_plan, render_plan
render_plan fields: prompt_seed, prompt_draft, prompt_polish, still_prompt_text, clip_prompt_seed, clip_positive_prompt, variation_profile, edit_intent
Strength: deterministic short-form MV planning, citypop lane maturity, workflow-specific prompt split
Risk: lexical style resolution brittleness, lane maturity imbalance, shared variation still/clip coupling
Recent work: clip contamination reduction and citypop wide still prompt re-anchoring
Stills consume still_prompt_text then apply still-constraint policy; clips consume clip_prompt_seed + clip_positive_prompt
- Still candidate_count exists but first candidate is auto-picked
- Non-citypop lanes are thinner and less optimized
- Clip prompts are cleaner now but still somewhat generic-safe
- Still-side latest re-anchor fix needs fresh-plan live validation
- Clip fallback contamination was recently reduced in code + live rerender history
trim windows, beat/bar snapping, cadence_profile_by_shot, snap_unit_by_shot, trimmed_coverage_by_shot, edit_intent_by_shot
Strength: not just concat — edit_intent/timing-aware assembly metadata is computed and surfaced to review
Risk: some assembly revision actions are still metadata-forward rather than always reassembling a new final video
Mux behavior uses ffmpeg concat demuxer + per-item inpoint/outpoint and -shortest with audio
scores, blocking/non-blocking checks, benchmark_dimensions, signal buckets, assembly_quality_summary, rerender targets/plan/payload/execution_payloads
Strength: rich structured diagnosis, manual findings ingestion, final MV publishability bucket, anti-slideshow / cadence / transition scoring
Risk: diagnosis breadth is ahead of execution breadth — some actions/fix_strategy values are only partially wired
Current important boundary: review completion != guaranteed product-level publishability quality
review packet / findings / notes / contact-sheet manifest
Manual review handoff when rerender_outcome.exhausted == true
• scheduler.py has a broken import surface, even though main runtime uses pipeline.py directly.
• Style lane source-of-truth is split: runtime relies on bible/prompting/rules, while signals/modes/materials/review remain parallel metadata.
• citypop is the most mature lane; non-citypop lanes are thinner and may yield uneven product quality.
• Still candidate_count exists but no ranking/select loop; first candidate is auto-picked.
• Review diagnosis is rich, but some recommended actions / fix_strategy values are not fully executable.
• Review packet scaffolding is strong, but frame extraction/contact-sheet image generation is not fully auto-closed.
• Clip contamination was reduced recently; still-side latest prompt re-anchor needs fresh-plan live validation.
• Product work is now mostly quality/contract/ops stabilization, not major architecture reconstruction.
